perspective:
From Bradley Ochoa’s available perspective:

- He is Bradley Ochoa, a salesperson at the marketing firm. Katherine Lasiloo is the marketing manager and his colleague. Their professional relationship is cordial but sometimes strained by disagreements over sales/marketing strategy.
- He prepared data and charts for a meeting to support traditional sales techniques, believing they were being overlooked in favor of newer digital strategies Katherine supports.
- In the meeting, he told Katherine he appreciated her digital strategies but thought core sales could benefit more from traditional methods. He heard Katherine say the market is evolving, digital outreach cannot be ignored, and she asked how he reconciled his data with rising online engagement. He replied he was not suggesting abandoning digital, but was frustrated that proven methods seemed sidelined without proper consideration. Katherine said she understood and suggested analyzing the data together to integrate both approaches.
- After the meeting, Katherine shared recent digital campaign success stories that boosted engagement and sales. Bradley asked her to explain how those strategies are developed. Katherine said it is about targeting the right audience with the right message and offered to walk him through analytics and decision-making. Bradley admitted he had doubts about moving away from traditional methods but was now interested in understanding digital. Katherine said she was glad he was open and suggested diving deeper into the data.
- Bradley proposed a joint strategy meeting to combine traditional and digital approaches. Katherine agreed to schedule a brainstorming/outlining session. Bradley said he was hopeful they could leverage both their expertise and appreciated her willingness to collaborate. Katherine said she looked forward to leveraging each other’s strengths.
- After the joint meeting, Bradley worked overtime preparing a board presentation integrating both their ideas. He showed Katherine a draft. She reviewed it, called it comprehensive and well thought out, and said his hard work showed. Bradley thanked her, said he was convinced the integrated approach would set them apart from competitors, and wanted to make sure they nailed the presentation. Katherine said she was confident and suggested reviewing and fine-tuning once more.
- Following the success of the presentation and implementation of the new strategy, Bradley felt grateful for his professional growth and the collaboration. He thanked Katherine, saying he learned much from her. Katherine said it was a pleasure and that his openness made it a successful partnership. Bradley proposed regular strategy sessions. Katherine agreed, saying regular sessions would keep them on top of their game and market trends.

He does not have access to information not observed, heard, told to him, or personally experienced in these interactions.
